subject: e2e/fixtures.ts:184 and :210 return document.fonts.ready from page.evaluate (the FontFaceSet gets serialised; it can stall WebKit)
body: In a WebKit smoke run, page.evaluate(() => document.fonts.ready) took 58 s and timed out an ink test, although every font had loaded in under 0.2 s (trace). learn.spec and search.spec already use document.fonts.ready.then(() => undefined). I fixed the ink spec's copy (0fe8c48). fixtures.ts:184 and :210 (the shared fixtures, not my file) have the same pattern and may cause rare timeouts in every spec that uses them.
